texto.muro: a wall of charcoal acoustic foam wedges, their rows of pyramids catching a faint edge of light

escena: SCENE (a recording session, studio in Lima, evening): the operator sits at the console LOW in the frame, sharp, one hand on a fader; the people recording are small, soft and out of focus behind the glass further back. The AZURE-BLUE glow of the faders and meters is the only light on their face and hands and it stays down there, at the console; the reserved foam wall above them is in even shadow with nothing crossing it. Caught AT THE INSTANT their hand eases the fader down and the meters drop. 50mm at f/2. Everything is completely unbranded.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of the console immediately under the lens
lecho.tono: DARK near black in shadow, matte
